description: HTML source code for a Database Viewer web interface with embedded CSS and JavaScript for fetching and displaying database and table data.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the server and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, showing a loading spinner during the fetch.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database entries and loads tables for the selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches tables for the selected database and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches data for the selected table and renders it in the main content area.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs and inserts the HTML table for the data received.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates individual table cell HTML, handling nulls, objects, and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content when clicked, toggling detailed view.
